independence_statement: I made these readings independently from visible ink in the original scan031 JPG and my own exact-box enlarged crops. I read only the assigned boxes TSV and CONVENTIONS.md as textual inputs. I did not open witnesses, page transcriptions, _first.tsv, comparison files, earlier crop notes, review records, other readers' outputs, or any other manuscript page. I used no OCR, recognition library, external research, or TeX compilation. All 29 final crops were personally displayed and inspected.
crop_method: Exact original-coordinate crops from the whole source JPG, enlarged with Pillow LANCZOS to 3000 pixels wide. Boxes B19, B20, B21, B22, and B27 were remade from the same source bounds at 3500 pixels, rotated clockwise 5 degrees with bicubic rotation, then resized with LANCZOS to 3500 pixels. No sharpening, autocontrast, erasure, or recognition was applied.
